q: Do you take a nap after lunch?
a: On weekdays, I'm usually too busy to take a nap after lunch. But at weekends, sometimes I take a nap after lunch because it makes me feel more energetic in the afternoon.
vocab: 在周末（注意：英国人说at weekends，而美国人则说on weekends）

q: What do you do when you stay up late?
a: I tend to stay up late to play video games. Sometimes I also stay up late to chat with my friends on social media.

q: How do you feel when you stayed up late the night before?
a: I feel tired and sleepy. And I tend to find it difficult to concentrate.
I usually don't. But if I wake up during a dream, I tend to remember it.
vocab: 在一个梦的过程当中醒来

q: Do you prefer a long break or several short breaks?
a: I prefer several short breaks because they make me feel more energetic and motivated. I can have a cup of coffee or go for a short walk and get some fresh air.

q: What do you usually do when you feel tired?
a: I usually listen to music or have a hot shower when I feel tired. And sometimes I take a nap, which makes me feel more energetic.
vocab: have a hot shower（英式）/ take a hot shower（美式）

q: What do you usually do when you feel bored?
a: I usually chat with my friends on social media when I feel bored. Sometimes I also play video games or go to the cinema.

q: Do you like fruit and vegetables?
a: Yes. I'm fond of fruit and vegetables, such as pears, tomatoes, and cucumbers. They are tasty and they improve my health because they're a good source of vitamins and fiber.
vocab: a good source of vitamins and fiber
是很好的维生素和纤维的来源（=rich in vitamins and fiber 富含维生素和纤维）

q: How often do you eat out?
a:
I eat out only once or twice a month. Most of the time, I eat at home because it's cheaper and healthier.

或者：
I eat out at least a few times a week. I have a busy lifestyle, so I tend to eat out when I don't have time to cook. Sometimes I eat out with friends, which is also a good way to socialise.
Some people, like myself, eat out to save time. Others eat out because restaurants offer a variety of food choices or they like to socialise in restaurants.

q: What are the differences between restaurant food and home-cooked food?
a: Restaurant food tends to taste better than home-cooked food, but it usually contains too much fat, salt or sugar. By contrast, home-cooked food is healthier and more nutritious, but it's not as tasty as restaurant food.
vocab: contain too much fat, salt or sugar
含有过多的脂肪、盐或者糖
更健康而且更有营养的

q: Do you think children should learn to cook?
a: Yes, I suppose they should because cooking is an important life skill. It can make children more independent. Children who know how to cook are also more likely to have a healthy diet.
vocab: 保持健康的饮食结构（对比：rely on fast food 依赖快餐）

q: Do you like watching cookery programmes on TV?
a:
Yes, I do because they can help me improve my cooking skills. I like watching them also because many TV chefs have a good sense of humour and they teach people to cook healthy meals.
